description: B.R.R Guardian Limited (BRRG) is a real estate development and marketing company incorporated in Pakistan on 16 December 2021 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 4 August 2023. Its business is the development and marketing of real estate — land, housing and commercial projects, multi-storey buildings, shopping centres and related facilities — and it brings property for rental purposes. It also operates BRR Security Vault, a locker and custodial facility opened in July 1989. The company acquired a modaraba business in the prior year; its Ijarah and Diminishing Musharakah businesses were discontinued after the amalgamation.
headOffice: 20th Floor, BRR Tower, Hassan Ali Street, off I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
